scope: Vendored pyinstrument profiler.py read whole and Git-object matched. Imported original file directly; deterministic record/report control only, no signals or process profiling hooks installed.

findings.detail: root_frame caches derived tree, Frame.time caches totals; _record adds raw samples without invalidation. Reproduced report1s then add2s: raw3s while report stays1s. Rendering midrun or reusing profiler needs explicit lifecycle qualification.
start replaces SIGALRM handler/timer or sys.setprofile; stop clears/ignores rather than restoring prior owner. Nested profilers/host instrumentation can interfere. Not executed.
stop does not record final elapsed interval since last sample. Short runs/final tails may have no samples; absence of samples is not zero runtime.
output_html expects style.css/profile.js/jquery-1.11.0.min.js under resources. None of those paths exist in pinned tree. No HTML generation attempted.
Text excludes children<=1 percent total; HTML excludes<=0.5 percent. Visible report is filtered sampled data, not complete cost accounting.
